description:
A terrified boy. A dusty piano room. And one question that unlocked the secret to confident speaking. In this talk, communication coach Ty Hoesgen shares the surprising way to remove pressure, calm your nerves, and speak at your best—whether you’re on a stage, in a meeting, or just introducing yourself. 

Ty Hoesgen is a communication coach, 3X best-selling author, and the Founder of Advanced Growth Institute. He helps professionals speak with confidence, charisma, and clarity—so they can gain more respect, become stronger leaders, and advance their careers.

Growing up as a shy, awkward farm kid, Ty struggled with communication for most of his life. Motivated by these struggles, he spent thousands of hours practicing and learning everything he could to master the art of communication. Determined to make others’ journeys less painful than his own, he became obsessed with figuring out the success formula for being an exceptional communicator. Ty now uses this formula to help profession
title: How introverts become better public speakers | Ty Hoesgen | TEDxUTD

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Throughout his journey from successful entrepreneur to neurodiversity campaigner and host of a hugely successful podcast, Alex Partridge has been haunted by the fear of rejection, being labelled ‘over-sensitive’ and fighting the desire to people-please and having to protect himself from emotional harm.

Alex’s talk draws on his own experience of Rejection Sensitive Dysphoria (RSD), the state of emotional dysregulation experienced by almost everyone with ADHD. He shares how it’s coloured every aspect of his life and he’ll use the insights he’s gained from the world’s top experts on ADHD to share with you simple steps to regaining boundaries, confidence and self-belief. Alex Partridge is a leading voice in the neurodiversity space, dedicated to unpacking the complexities of living and working with ADHD. Alex was previously best known as the founder of social media giants UNILAD and LADbible. From just 21 years old, Alex experienced the high highs of building global audiences of over 100
title: Why ADHD Makes Rejection More Painful | Alex Partridge | TEDxManchester

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Un encuentro entre un paleontólogo, una experta en migraciones, una líder social, una cuentista, un matemático y un físico. Alberto Boscaini, Corina Lang, Malena Famá, Raquel López Cascales, Eduardo Sáenz de Cabezón y Gerry Garbulsky exploran el tiempo desde escalas que van de millones de años a fracciones de segundo. Alberto Boscaini es paleontólogo de vertebrados, investigador del CONICET en la UBA y National Geographic Explorer. De origen italiano y con estudios en Italia, España y Argentina, se especializa en la megafauna sudamericana, con un foco muy particular: los perezosos gigantes. Su última publicación fue el “Auge y caída de los perezosos gigantes”, en la revista Science.

Corina Lang es psicóloga y doctora en Psicología Social, especializada en integración social de grupos vulnerables. A lo largo de su carrera lideró programas para migrantes, refugiados, infancia en riesgo y personas con discapacidad en organizaciones como ACNUR, HIAS, AMIA, Taglit y la Universidad de Haif
title: Escalas de tiempo | Tiempo de conversar  | TEDxRiodelaPlata

author: TEDx Talks
description: What might happen if we create a NOW generation that is defined by action instead of age? Harkening back to the civil rights era of the 1950s and 60s, Clanton shows how movements are multiplying and changing. But they all have one thing in common—committed people refusing to let hate maintain power.  WAIKINYA CLANTON, J.S., is a seventh generation Mississippian and first-ever State Director of the Southern Poverty Law Center. As she works on pressing issues in Mississippi, Clanton prioritizes collaboration and focuses on building coalitions among grassroots organizations, legislators, and community leaders. Her strategic vision aims to empower local communities, ensuring they have the necessary tools and resources to advocate for themselves. Clanton is the creator of the ANCHRD framework: a systematic approach for people to engage in civic life that prioritizes rootedness over recognition, co-creation over charity, and sustained commitment over viral moments. title: Hate has No Place in the NOW Generation | Waikinya Clanton | TEDxUniversityofMississippi

author: TEDx Talks
description:
How does a child who used a doctor’s note to skip PE grow up to finish the Ironman World Championship and donate a kidney? It wasn’t through grit alone. It was through curiosity.
Elizabeth Young spent her childhood avoiding exercise at all costs. Then, in her 20s, one small question changed everything: “What if I just tried?”

In this inspiring talk, Elizabeth takes you on a visual photo journey of her improbable transformation. You’ll see the child who avoided exercise evolve into a life-saving kidney donor and, ultimately, an Ironman World Champion, exploring the power of curiosity and the two simple words: "What if?" She reveals how that same simple shift can help you shatter your deepest self-imposed limits and rewrite your own story into something more incredible than you ever dared to imagine. Elizabeth Young is a Licensed Professional Counselor, global speaker, and coach with over 25 years of experience helping individuals unlock their greatest potential. Starting her journey i
title: What If? Two Words That Can Change Your Life | Elizabeth Young | TEDxChadwick International School

In this inspiring TEDx talk, entrepreneur and medical student Aditya Joshi shares how ancient wisdom, self-belief, and courageous action can help young people transform their lives. Drawing from philosophy, personal achievements, and real-world experiences, he highlights how choosing growth over comfort and speaking your vision into existence can unlock limitless potential.

This talk is a powerful reminder that your background does not define you — your mindset does. Aditya Joshi is a 3rd-year MBBS student, entrepreneur, and founder of Aditya Joshi Mentorship and Strivea LLP. A first-generation doctor from Haridwar, he has built one of India’s largest AIIMS student mentorship communities connecting aspirants directly with toppers. title: From Invisible Potential to Inevitable Success | Aditya Joshi | TEDxBadhkal Lake

description:
What do you do when life hands you something you never asked for — an illness, an injustice, a culture you don't understand? The instinct is to fight. To resist. To ask: why me?

After almost twenty years of living in South Korea as an Italian public figure, Alberto Mondi has faced that question more than once — through a life-changing medical diagnosis, the invisible challenges of adapting to a culture radically different from his own, and a sudden and painful public crisis that threatened everything he had built. His answer, learned the hard way, is not what you might expect. Alberto Mondi is an Italian television personality who has lived in South Korea for almost twenty years. Known to Korean audiences through programmes such as "Abnormal Summit" (JTBC) and "Welcome, First Time in Korea?" (MBC), he has become one of the most recognisable foreign voices in Korean media. His recent appearance in the Netflix production "Can This Love Be Translated?" brought his story to a global audi

description: What happens when society writes the story of a young girl before she even gets to tell it herself? Tamia's talk explores the pressures, stereotypes, and labels placed on adolescent girls, and how these expectations shape self-image and confidence.  Through personal stories and research on girls' development, Tamia examines how social conditioning, peer influence, and social media reinforce harmful narratives - and how girls might navigate, resist, and ultimately reclaim their voices. Tamia invites adults and peers alike to recognise the impacts of these narratives and to support young women in discovering their authentic selves. A self-motivated AWS Certified Solution Architect, AWS DevSecOps, and Data Engineer with over 18 years of experience in IT. Involved in Build Automation, Application Development, Quality Engineering, continuous improvement and automating the entire life cycle using the latest DevOps tools and techniques from design and architecture, through implementation, deployment, and successful operations. author: TEDx Talks
description: À 23 ans, Mona se lance dans l’entrepreneuriat. Sa start-up connaît un succès rapide : médias, clients, collaborations avec les plus grandes marques… jusqu’à l’effondrement et la liquidation judiciaire prématurée de l’entreprise. Dans ce talk, elle raconte comment elle a vécu l’échec, mais surtout, comment elle a transformé ce crash en leçon de résilience et en nouvelle trajectoire. Elle nous transmet alors les clés pour apprendre à échouer et à voir ce qui nous arrive dans la vie avec un autre regard. Entrepreneure, créatrice de contenu et podcasteuse, elle a fondé RESAP Paris, une marque pionnière de l’upcycling qui a collaboré avec Levi’s ou les Galeries Lafayette. À travers son podcast Note à moi-même, elle inspire chaque jour une communauté à entreprendre leur vie autant que leur business. Convaincue que la réussite commence par la connaissance de soi, elle crée aujourd’hui des expériences - bootcamps, conférences, lives - mêlant entrepreneuriat, introspection et transformation p
title: Apprendre à échouer | Mona Boujtita | TEDxIAEMontpellier

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Who you are and who you ultimately become is shaped by what you believe and where you direct your attention. The ideas you hold about yourself influence the choices you make and the actions you repeat each day. As Aristotle observed, “You are what you repeatedly do,” reminding us that our habits ultimately define us. 
Yet the habits we form are guided by our beliefs about what is possible. When students believe their abilities can grow through effort, practice, and learning, they are more likely to persist through challenges and improve over time (a concept known as a growth mindset). For educators, helping students truly believe this is something of a “holy grail.” When students internalize a growth mindset, they become more resilient, more willing to take risks, and better prepared to turn setbacks into opportunities for learning and growth. Charlton Jackson is the Middle School Principal at Chadwick International, a role he has held since 2020. A lifelong member of the Chadwick com
title: The Power of Belief! | Charlton Jackson | TEDxChadwick International School

Through personal insights and decades of experience in biomedical technology, he highlights how emerging preventive technologies can help identify health risks years before symptoms appear. This talk is a powerful call to shift from reactive treatment to proactive living — improving survival, reducing medical burden, and ultimately adding life to years, not just years to life. Dr Navil Prasad Edathil is a healthcare technology leader and Director of KTPL Technologies Pvt Ltd with nearly three decades of experience in biomedical engineering and medical device infrastructure. He is recognised for building scalable healthcare service networks and advancing technology-led healthcare access. title: The Missing Smoke Alarm in Healthcare | Dr.Navil Prasad Edathil | TEDxBadhkal Lake

Ana began her career at Merrill Lynch, where she completed FINRA Series 7, 66, 9, and 10 licenses, and later served as a Vice President Risk Officer at Morgan Stanley, providing supervisory oversight and regulatory guidance. author: TEDx Talks
description:
Que se passe-t-il lorsque nos mouvements, notre respiration et nos émotions deviennent lisibles par une intelligence artificielle ?
Julia Ayache, chercheuse en sciences du mouvement humain, explore comment nos gestes et notre synchronisation avec les autres façonnent l’empathie.
À travers ses travaux sur les interactions avec des agents virtuels capables de réagir à nos signaux corporels, elle interroge les défis scientifiques et les questions éthiques posées par l’émergence d’une IA empathique. Chercheuse postdoctorale à l’Université de Montpellier, au sein du laboratoire EuroMov. Ancienne cheffe de projet digital, elle s’est spécialisée dans l’étude du togetherness - le sentiment d’être ensemble - dans les espaces virtuels. Sa thèse, financée par une bourse Marie Skłodowska-Curie, explore comment les corps et les esprits interagissent à distance, entre empathie, synchronie et connexion. À travers ses recherches, Julia questionne les promesses et les limites des technologies immersiv
title: La thérapeute virtuelle : science et éthique de l’IA incarnée | Julia Ayache | TEDxIAEMontpellier

author: TEDx Talks
description:
This talk explores how being labeled as “full of potential” can quietly become a source of fear rather than motivation. It examines how early praise and high expectations can shift a person’s focus from growth to image management, making failure feel like proof of inadequacy instead of part of learning. Through personal experience, the talk highlights how success can create pressure to maintain a reputation, leading to risk-avoidance and self-doubt. 
Drawing on psychological research about mindset, it explains why praise centered on ability can limit development. Ultimately, the talk argues that real growth begins when individuals choose to risk being average, imperfect, or wrong. By redefining failure as a tool rather than a threat, we can step beyond expectations and reclaim the freedom to learn, experiment, and grow. SeoYun Kim is a middle school student at Chadwick International with a strong interest in politics, international relations, and public speaking. She actively particip

Onni believes that by forging metal, we learn to forge connections. He argues that connecting to the things we create also connects us to ourselves and the people around us. Onni has Icelandic and Finnish heritage. In addition to learning blacksmithing, he translates Old Norse literature into English and writes poetry. author: TEDx Talks
description:
In this TEDx Talk, Travis Atkinson challenges how communities respond to people in mental health crises, and he argues that love is the missing ingredient in our behavioral health system.
Drawing on historical research and personal experience, he shows how fear-based, punitive approaches have shaped crisis care, and how a better path already exists. Using the Greek concept of agape, a selfless and intentional love expressed through action, Atkinson highlights pioneers who transformed crisis services by listening deeply, taking bold risks, and caring longer than required.
 Travis Atkinson is a mental health advocate who challenges how communities respond to people in crisis. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

Through storytelling and systems insight, Valerie invites audiences to rethink power, accountability, and whose voices shape the decisions that affect families’ lives.

description:
Prof. Dr. Mustafa Özdoğan, hitabeti, anlatımının akıcılığı, eşsiz hikayesi ve tecrübeleriyle dinleyiclerine unutulmaz bir deneyim sunuyor. 1968 Niğde doğumlu Prof. Dr. Mustafa Özdoğan, 150'den fazla bilimsel makalesi, yenilikçi tedavi yaklaşımları ve dijital sağlık girişimleriyle tanınan bir Tıbbi Onkoloji Uzmanıdır.

Kişiselleştirilmiş kanser tedavileri, immünoterapi, moleküler profilleme ve yapay zeka uygulamalarına odaklanmaktadır. 2025'te bir yıl içinde 12 farklı Q1 dergide makale yayımladı; Nature Communications, Frontiers in Oncology ve Viruses dergilerinde özel sayı editörlüğü üstlendi.

Aynı yıl iki önemli kitabın editörlüğünü gerçekleştirdi: HPV ilişkili kanserleri küresel ölçekte ele alan "Papillomavirus-Induced Oncogenesis" ve Türkiye'de ilk ulusal referans eser "Kalıtsal Kanserler Kitabı".

description:
Anıl Şehirlioğlu, hitabeti, anlatımının akıcılığı, eşsiz hikayesi ve tecrübeleriyle dinleyiclerine unutulmaz bir deneyim sunuyor. 16 Nisan 1981'de İstanbul'da doğan konuşmacımız, İstanbul Üniversitesi Turizm İşletme Bölümü'nden mezun olduktan sonra uzun yıllar kurumsal dünyada görev aldı. Ancak zamanla daha derin bir sorgulamaya yöneldi: İnsan gerçekten kimdir ve potansiyelinin ne kadarını yaşayabilir?

2008'de kuantum ve bilinç çalışmalarıyla tanışması bir kırılma noktası oldu. Kurumsal kariyerini geride bırakarak insan zihni, bilinçaltı ve dönüşüm süreçleri üzerine yoğunlaşan bir yolculuğa başladı.

Kuantum Uygulamaları, Şamanik çalışmalar, Reiki, Access Bars ve pek çok farklı yöntemi araştırdı; bunları kendi deneyimiyle sentezledi.

2012'de İstanbul Bakırköy'de Rengârenk Yaşam Akademisi'ni kurdu. Bugün Beylikdüzü'ndeki merkezinde 11 kişilik ekibiyle bireysel kuantum çalışmaları, Kuantum Drama uygulamaları ve dönüşüm kampları gerçekleştiriyor.

Çalışma ve Sosyal Güvenlik Bakanlığı o
title: Hayatınızı Yaşadığınızı Sanıyorsunuz, Oysa Bilinçaltınız Yaşıyor | Anıl Şehirlioğlu | TEDxBebek

author: TEDx Talks
description:
When music becomes a language of the soul and philosophy finds its voice, we witness melodies that transcend words and touch the eternal. 
Rooted in tradition yet soaring with thought, in this talk, Manjusha Kulkarni Patil beautifully connects music with PANCHATATVA ,the essence of life.
 
In her talk, she talks about how the five elements of life that is air, water, fire, space and earth mirror the true essence of music, where each element shapes its foundation, flow, energy, breath, and resonance. Together, they create a harmony, making music a living expression of the human spirit. Manjusha Kulkarni Patil, revered as Swar Manjusha, is a distinguished Hindustani Classical Vocalist of the Gwalior Agra Gharana. A gold medalist in M.A. Music, she is the recipient of several prestigious national honors, including the Sangeet Natak Akademi's Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar, the Kumar Gandharva Rashtriya Puraskar, and the Gaansaraswati Puraskar.

She is a Top Grade Artist of All India
title: The Elements of Music  | Manjusha Patil | TEDxRajdhani College

author: TEDx Talks
description:
When Arts Speak, Communities Listen explores how creativity becomes a civic language—shaping identity, challenging misinformation, and giving voice to communities too often unheard. Through lived experience and cultural storytelling, LeJuane “El’Ja” Bowens reveals how art doesn’t just reflect society—it activates it.
 LeJuane “El’Ja” Bowens is an award-winning spoken word poet, author, host, and arts educator whose work bridges storytelling, culture, and community empowerment. Born in Detroit, Michigan and raised in Lima, Ohio, he served six years in the US Army, including two deployments to Iraq—an experience that shaped his voice and commitment to creative expression.
El’Ja has collaborated with major national arts and community orgs, including The Kennedy Center, National Endowment for the Arts, Poetry Foundation, & Wounded Warrior Project, using poetry as a tool for healing, advocacy, & connection. He has been featured at notable cultural events such as the National Folk Festival
title: When Arts Speak, Communities Listen | LeJuane Bowens | TEDxFaurot Park

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Dr. Cem Yılmaz; hitabeti, anlatımının akıcılığı, eşsiz hikayesi ve tecrübeleriyle dinleyiclerine unutulmaz bir deneyim sunuyor 1976 Ankara doğumlu Dr. Cem Yılmaz, Ankara Üniversitesi Tıp Fakültesi'nden 2000 yılında mezun olduktan sonra Ankara Numune Hastanesi'nde meme kanseri ve tiroid hastalıkları üzerine ihtisasını tamamladı. Mecburi hizmetinin ardından 2009'da Bursa Asker Hastanesi'nde görev alırken, akademik çalışmalarını derinleştirdi.

Kariyerinin dönüm noktası, Avrupa Onkoloji Enstitüsü'nde meme kanserinde koruyucu cerrahinin öncüsü Dr. Umberto Veronesi ile çalışması oldu. Ardından European Academy of Senology'de Dr. Mahdi Rezai ile 5000'in üzerinde onkoplastik meme cerrahisi ve rekonstrüksiyon ameliyatı gerçekleştirdi.

2010'da Avrupa Meme Bilimi Akademisi'ne kabul edilen en genç Avrupalı meme cerrahı unvanını aldı ve halen bu akademide eğitim vermektedir.

Yılmaz'ın asıl vizyonu, bilgiyi topluma yaymakta kendini gösterdi. 2010'da başlattığı SENA Projesi ile Türkiye'nin ilk Se
title: Neştersiz Dönüşüm | Cem Yılmaz | TEDxBebek

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Erhan Bayrak, hitabeti, anlatımının akıcılığı, eşsiz hikayesi ve tecrübeleriyle dinleyiclerine unutulmaz bir deneyim sunuyor Erhan Bayrak, Türk müzik yapımcısı, aranjör, besteci ve Bayrak Records Stüdyo'nun kurucusudur.

1976 yılında Aydın'da dünyaya gelen müzik adamının yolculuğu 1988'de Aydın'da, profesyonel kariyeri ise 1993'te İstanbul'a gelişiyle başladı. 1993-1999 yılları arasında İTÜ Devlet Konservatuarı Kompozisyon Bölüm Başkanı Dr. Nail Yavuzoğlu ile klasik batı müziği, solfej, piano ve armonizasyon; Faris Akarsu ile batı müziği solfeji; Rachelle Eliza Bruni ile klasik piano eğitimi aldı. Aynı dönemde Mutlu Torun ve Doç. M. Cahit Atasoy ile türk musikisi solfeji ve nazariyat dersleri aldı.

Bayrak, yıllardır Türk müzik sektöründeki sanatçıların çoğu için yaptığı prodüksiyonlar ve aranjmanlarla tanınmaktadır. Cesur adımları ve farklı müzikal fikirleriyle yeni soundlara öncülük etti. Türkiye'deki ilgi ve takdirin yanı sıra Ortadoğu, Balkanlar ve Avrupa'da da tanınarak global ça
title: Müzikte Bayrak Etkisi | Erhan Bayrak | TEDxBebek

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Ceren Yalçın, hitabeti, anlatımının akıcılığı, eşsiz hikayesi ve tecrübeleriyle dinleyiclerine unutulmaz bir deneyim sunuyor. Ceren Yalçın, lisans eğitimini King’s College London’da Nörobilim alanında tamamladı. Bu süreçte, özellikle yaşlanmayla ilişkili nörolojik hastalıklar üzerine çalışmaya başladı ve beynin yaşlanma sürecinde nasıl değiştiğine odaklanan araştırmalar yürüttü.

Yüksek lisans eğitimini Imperial College London’da Nöroteknoloji alanında tamamladı. Bu dönemde sinir sistemi ile teknoloji arasındaki etkileşimleri inceleyerek, beyin fonksiyonlarının teknolojik yöntemlerle nasıl ölçülebileceği ve modüle edilebileceği üzerine uzmanlaştı.

Yüksek lisansın ardından bir yıl boyunca araştırma asistanı olarak çalıştı ve bu süreç, doktora araştırmalarının da temelini oluşturdu. Doktora çalışmaları, ultrason ile beyin modülasyonu üzerine odaklanıyor. Araştırmalarının temel amacı; demans ve yaşlanmaya bağlı hafıza ile bilişsel gerilemelerin önlenmesine yönelik, invaziv olmayan nörot
title: Beyin Nasıl Dönüşür? | Ceren Yalçın | TEDxBebek

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Fatih Kadir Akın, hitabeti, anlatımının akıcılığı, eşsiz hikayesi ve tecrübeleriyle dinleyiclerine unutulmaz bir deneyim sunuyor. Fatih Kadir Akın, İstanbul doğumlu bir yazılım geliştirici, yazar ve topluluk gönüllüsüdür. Açık kaynak dünyasındaki üretimleri ve topluluk çalışmalarıyla tanınır; özellikle ChatGPT’nin ilk günlerinde yayımladığı prompts.chat (http://prompts.chat) projesiyle, yapay zekâ ile etkileşime dair pratiklerin yaygınlaşmasına katkı sağlamıştır.

Aynı zamanda micro-girişimci olan Akın, 2025 yılında GitHub tarafından GitHub Star unvanına layık görülmüştür.

Hâlihazırda Teknasyon’da Geliştirici İlişkileri Yöneticisi olarak çalışmakta; 2012’den bu yana Türkiye ve dünyanın farklı yerlerinde konferanslar ve etkinliklerde konuşmalar yaparak yazılım, üretken yapay zekâ ve geliştirici kültürü üzerine bilgi ve deneyimlerini paylaşmaktadır. title: Tembellik: İnsanlığın En Üretken Kusuru | Fatih Kadir Akın | TEDxBebek

author: TEDx Talks
description: Before language is learned, rhythm is felt, and culture is remembered. Siyakhona Youth Development brings traditional Xhosa music to life, showing how heritage can be preserved, shared, and celebrated through the voices of the next generation.  As the Siyakhona Youth Development, we do arts and culture activities such as drama, music, poetry, gamboots dance, and traditional dance. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Traditional Song | Siyakhona Youth Development  | TEDxGeorge
